title: Start
empty_state_description: Connect a GitHub repository to get started.

preview.site_description_explanation: Your site's title and description, as they appear on the landing page and in search results.
preview.welcome_explanation: The introductory content visitors see when they arrive at your site. This comes from your site's index page.
preview.stories_explanation: Your story collection as it appears on the landing page. Drag to reorder — this controls the display order on your published site.
preview.stories_intro_placeholder: Add an optional intro for the stories section
preview.stories_intro_hint: Optional — shown above your stories if you add it.
preview.objects_explanation: Featured objects from your collection, displayed on the landing page.
preview.empty_default_hint: Empty fields show your site's localised default.

status_bar.manage_repos: Switch, add, or remove GitHub Repos

hint: Drag to reorder — this controls the order on your published site

delete_story.title: Delete story
delete_story.body: Delete '{{title}}'? This will remove the story and its {{count}} steps from the Compositor. Your published site won't change until you publish again.

soft_limit.stories: You have {{count}} stories. Performance may be affected with more than 10.
soft_limit.projects: You have {{count}} projects. The limit is 5 connected repositories.

sync_modal.title: Repository has changed
sync_modal.no_changes_body: GitHub has new commits, but they bring no changes to apply in the Compositor. You don't need to do anything.
sync_modal.editor_only_note_one: You have 1 unpublished change in the Compositor. Applying leaves it as it is, and your next publish sends it to GitHub.
sync_modal.editor_only_note_other: You have {{count}} unpublished changes in the Compositor. Applying leaves them as they are, and your next publish sends them to GitHub.
sync_modal.error_colliding_columns: The sheet "{{sheet}}" has columns Telar reads as one ({{columns}}), and each of them has values. Telar can't build the site from a sheet like this, so nothing was synced. Keep only the column you want, delete the others from the sheet on GitHub or in Google Sheets, and then try again.
sync_modal.error_sheet_unreadable: We couldn't read the sheet "{{sheet}}" from GitHub, so nothing was synced. Try again in a moment.
sync_modal.error_file_unreadable: We couldn't read the file "{{file}}" from GitHub, so nothing was synced. Try again in a moment.
sync_modal.error_ignore_list_unreadable: We couldn't read the list of stories you chose to ignore from GitHub, so nothing was synced. Try again in a moment.
sync_modal.error_entries_refused: The Compositor couldn't apply these changes, so nothing was changed. This is a problem in the Compositor, not in your site: please use Report a problem so we can fix it.
sync_modal.error_terms_not_added: Some glossary terms from GitHub could not be added. Try again to add them.
sync_modal.content_summary: Steps in the Compositor: {{d1}}. On GitHub: {{head}}. Different: {{count}}.
sync_modal.content_steps_deleted: This story's steps were deleted on GitHub. If you use GitHub's version, the story will have no steps. If you keep yours, your next publish puts its steps back on GitHub.
sync_modal.content_unreadable: We can't read this story's files on GitHub, so you can only keep your version. Your next publish replaces the story's files on GitHub with it.
sync_modal.content_reason_step_not_plain: Row {{row}} gives its step number as "{{step}}", which isn't a plain number.
sync_modal.content_reason_step_too_precise: The step number "{{step}}" in row {{row}} has too many digits for the site to read it as one number.
sync_modal.content_reason_step_repeated: Step {{step}} appears twice: it is also written as "{{earlier}}".
sync_modal.content_reason_layer_number_repeated: The step in row {{row}} has two panels numbered {{layer}}.
sync_modal.content_reason_layer_reference_not_plain: A panel names its file in a form the site can't read: {{reference}}
sync_modal.content_reason_layer_reference_directory: A panel names a folder instead of a file: {{reference}}
sync_modal.content_reason_layer_reference_non_ascii: A panel names a file with accented or non-English letters, and no file has exactly that name: {{reference}}
sync_modal.content_reason_columns_collide: More than one column for "{{column}}" holds values: {{headers}}
sync_modal.content_inconclusive_apply_note: If you apply the other changes now, your site stays out of sync with GitHub until we can read the story files.
sync_modal.success_inconclusive: Your changes were applied. Your site is still out of sync with GitHub, because we couldn't read the story files.
sync_modal.story_changed_none_applied_one: {{stories}} changed while you were reviewing it, so none of your changes were applied. The list has been refreshed. Review it and apply your changes again.
sync_modal.story_changed_none_applied_other: {{stories}} changed while you were reviewing them, so none of your changes were applied. The list has been refreshed. Review it and apply your changes again.
sync_modal.object_changed_none_applied_one: {{objects}} changed while you were reviewing it, so none of your changes were applied. The list has been refreshed. Review it and apply your changes again.
sync_modal.object_changed_none_applied_other: {{objects}} changed while you were reviewing them, so none of your changes were applied. The list has been refreshed. Review it and apply your changes again.
sync_modal.error_story_failed: We couldn't save GitHub's version of {{stories}}, so your site is still out of sync. Your other changes were applied. Try again.
sync_modal.page_added_menu: It goes into your site's menu where GitHub's menu has it.
sync_modal.page_deleted: This page was deleted on GitHub.
sync_modal.page_deleted_conflict: This page was deleted on GitHub, but you edited it in the Compositor. Choose whether to delete it or keep your version.
sync_modal.page_deleted_renamed_here: This page was deleted on GitHub, but you changed its URL in the Compositor. Choose whether to delete it or keep it.
sync_modal.page_deleted_menu: Its menu entry will be removed too.
sync_modal.page_edited_renamed_here: This page changed on GitHub after you changed its URL in the Compositor. Choose which version to keep. Its new URL stays either way.
sync_modal.page_added_both: A page was added with this URL both on GitHub and in the Compositor. Choose which version to keep.
sync_modal.page_not_on_github: This page isn't on GitHub, and we can't tell whether it was deleted there or added here. If you keep it, your next publish adds it to GitHub.
sync_modal.pages_inconclusive_apply_note: If you apply the other changes now, your site stays out of sync with GitHub until we can read the page files.
sync_modal.success_pages_inconclusive: Your changes were applied. Your site is still out of sync with GitHub, because we couldn't read the page files.
sync_modal.page_changed_none_applied_one: {{pages}} changed while you were reviewing it, so none of your changes were applied. The list has been refreshed. Review it and apply your changes again.
sync_modal.page_changed_none_applied_other: {{pages}} changed while you were reviewing them, so none of your changes were applied. The list has been refreshed. Review it and apply your changes again.
sync_modal.error_page_failed: We couldn't save GitHub's version of {{pages}}, so your site is still out of sync. Your other changes were applied. Try again.
sync_modal.accept_divergence_stale: GitHub changed while you were reviewing the differences, so we didn't save your choice. These are the latest changes.

review.title: Changes on GitHub
review.intro: Made on GitHub after your last publish. For each one, choose which version your site keeps. Nothing changes until you apply.
review.note_publish_restores: Your next publish puts it back on GitHub.
review.note_publish_adds: Your next publish adds it to GitHub.
review.fields_github: Edited on GitHub: {{fields}}. You have not changed it here.
review.fields_both: Edited on GitHub and here after your last publish: {{fields}}.
review.fields_differs: GitHub's version differs from the Compositor's: {{fields}}.
review.text_github: Its text was edited on GitHub. You have not changed it here.
review.text_both: Its text was edited on GitHub and here after your last publish.
review.text_differs: Its text on GitHub differs from the Compositor's.
review.details_github: Its title or other details were edited on GitHub. You have not changed them here.
review.details_both: Its title or other details were edited on GitHub and here after your last publish.
review.details_differs: Its title or other details on GitHub differ from the Compositor's.
review.setting_github: Changed on GitHub. You have not changed it here.
review.setting_both: Changed on GitHub and here after your last publish.
review.setting_differs: GitHub's value differs from the Compositor's.
review.added_differs: On GitHub, but not in the Compositor.
review.deleted_here: Edited on GitHub. You deleted it here after your last publish.
review.deleted_github: Deleted on GitHub. You have not changed it here.
review.deleted_both: Deleted on GitHub. You edited it here after your last publish.
review.missing_differs: In the Compositor, but not on GitHub.
review.story_details_too: Its title or other details changed too, and your choice covers them.
review.notice_version: Your site on GitHub uses Telar {{version}}, and the Compositor follows it.
review.notice_pages_added_one: A page added on GitHub, which applying adds here too:
review.notice_pages_added_other: Pages added on GitHub, which applying adds here too:
review.pending_both_one: Choose a version for the change made in both places. Apply waits until you do.
review.pending_both_other: Choose a version for the {{count}} changes made in both places. Apply waits until you do.
review.pending_one: Choose a version for 1 change. Apply waits until you do.
review.pending_other: Choose a version for {{count}} changes. Apply waits until you do.
review.act_order: takes GitHub's order of your objects
review.pub_overwrite: saves the Compositor's version of {{names}} over GitHub's
review.bad_what: Edited on GitHub, and some of its characters can't be read. Your site leaves this story out until the file is repaired.
review.bad_what_name_shown: Edited on GitHub, and some of its characters can't be read. Your site shows the file's name in place of its text until the file is repaired.
review.bad_what_build_stops: Edited on GitHub, and some of its characters can't be read. Your site can't update until the file is repaired.
review.bad_use_gh_note: Characters that can't be read become �.
review.bad_keep_note: The edits made to this file on GitHub are lost.
review.nocheck_what: The Compositor couldn't compare this story with GitHub, because its texts folder holds a symlink (a shortcut to another folder).
review.nocheck_truncated: The Compositor couldn't compare your stories with GitHub, because the repository holds more files than GitHub lists at once.
review.nocheck_stories_link: The Compositor couldn't compare your stories with GitHub, because a folder that holds them is a symlink or a submodule (a shortcut to another folder or repository).
review.nocheck_pages_link: The Compositor couldn't compare your pages with GitHub, because the folder that holds them is a symlink or a submodule (a shortcut to another folder or repository).
review.nocheck_pages_truncated: The Compositor couldn't compare your pages with GitHub, because the repository holds more files than GitHub lists at once.
review.nocheck_keep_note: Your next publish saves the Compositor's text for this story over GitHub's.
review.nocheck_keep_note_all: Your next publish saves the Compositor's text for your stories over GitHub's.
review.nocheck_pages_keep_note: Your next publish saves the Compositor's text for your pages over GitHub's.
review.held_term: Its ID publishes no term on your site, and GitHub's glossary keeps it as a row the Compositor doesn't edit. Applying removes it here; it stays in the file on GitHub.
review.pending_stories_one: Choose a version for 1 story. Apply waits until you do.
review.pending_stories_other: Choose a version for {{count}} stories. Apply waits until you do.
review.request_stories: The Compositor couldn't read your story files on GitHub just now, so it can't tell whether any story changed there.
review.request_pages: The Compositor couldn't read your page files on GitHub just now, so it can't tell whether any page changed there.
review.img_what: Added to the objects folder on GitHub, with no object for it.
review.img_add_note: The object's ID is {{id}}, from the file name. You can add a title and other details on the Objects tab.
review.img_skip_note: The file stays in your repository.
